note: NAB's FY2025 Pillar 3 disclosed average LGD and EaD post-CCF and post-CRM (in $AUD millions) for the 'other retail' Basel exposure class (Table CR6, as at 30 Sep 2025), the same proxy category used for pd_base in pd_base_assumptions.csv. EaD post-CCF and post-CRM is the fully Basel-adjusted exposure figure (on-balance-sheet exposure net of collateral/guarantees plus the credit-equivalent amount of off-balance-sheet commitments); the report's separate 'on-balance sheet EaD pre-CRM', 'off-balance sheet EaD pre-CCF and pre-CRM', and 'average CCF' columns are intentionally not used here since they are intermediate components of this same figure, not additional exposure. 'Other retail' is broader than unsecured personal lending (it can include small-business retail exposures), so this is the closest disclosed proxy for this segment, not an exact category match. EAD is a portfolio-level aggregate for NAB's whole 'other retail' book, not a per-loan or per-customer figure.
